antim-bus.title: रातको अन्तिम बस (The Last Night Bus)
antim-bus.genre: mild horror / suspense, all ages, warm ending
antim-bus.style: night-thriller: reuse episodes/2026-11-28-antim-bus-1/story.js helpers (bRoad, bInterior, bConductor, bDriverBack, bMirror, bAama, bBasket, bTicket, bFrame('भाग N'), spot, bFog). Copy that file and change scenes.
canon: Last night bus Pokhara to Kathmandu on the foggy Mugling road
Kalikhola is a FICTIONAL old roadside stop the driver says a flood washed away twenty years ago
Her ticket: Sunaulo Yatayat Sewa, Pokhara to Kalikhola, Rs 2, dated 2061/05/12
Lights died, she vanished, her basket stayed on the seat and shook by itself

parts.title: भाग १
parts.summary: Old woman boards, asks for Kalikhola, 2061 ticket, lights out, she vanishes, basket shakes (cliffhanger).

parts.title: भाग २ — टोकरीभित्र
parts.plan: Recap hook in 2 s ('टोकरी आफैँ हल्लियो… भित्र के थियो?'). Vikas lifts the red cloth: an old brass lantern lights itself, plus a folded note: 'मोडमा बिस्तारै, कालीखोलामा रोक्नु।' Driver laughs it off, speeds up. Near a blind hairpin bend the lantern flame turns red; Vikas shouts 'बिस्तारै दाइ!'; driver brakes; a truck with no headlights roars past exactly where they would have been (near miss, no crash, no injuries). Silence. In the rear-view mirror the old woman is sitting in her seat again, pointing ahead: 'कालीखोला आयो, बाबु।' Cliffhanger. CTA: 'के उनी भूत हुन् कि रक्षक? भाग ३ मा थाहा पाउनुहोस्!'

parts.title: भाग ३ — कालीखोला
parts.plan: Bus stops in fog where the old stop used to be: only a broken tea-shop sign 'कालीखोला चिया पसल' and a stone bench. The woman steps off and says 'राति बाटो चिप्लो हुन्छ, यात्रुलाई होसियारसाथ पुर्‍याउनू।' Moments later a small landslide of mud and rocks slides onto the road ahead where the bus would have been (shown from a distance, nobody hurt). Driver and Vikas realise she warned them. Vikas finds in the basket a faded newspaper photo: the tea-shop aama who used to warn drivers on rainy nights. Lantern and basket fade away; on the seat lies a fresh 2-rupee ticket. Narrator: 'भन्छन्, अहिले पनि कुहिरो लागेको रात उनी अन्तिम बस कुर्छिन्।' Warm, eerie ending, road-safety undertone. CTA: 'तपाईंले रातको यात्रामा कहिल्यै अनौठो अनुभव गर्नुभएको छ? कमेन्टमा लेख्नुहोस्!' Then mark the series complete.
